import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-news-categories', templateUrl: './news-categories.component.html', }) export class NewsCategoriesComponent { activeCategory = 'all'; categories = [ { id: 'all', name: 'Toutes les actualités', icon: 'ri-newspaper-line', count: 12 }, { id: 'articles', name: 'Articles', icon: 'ri-article-line', count: 5 }, { id: 'themes', name: 'Thèmes', icon: 'ri-hashtag', count: 3 }, { id: 'elus', name: 'Élus et Secrétariat', icon: 'ri-government-line', count: 2 }, { id: 'development', name: 'Développement communal', icon: 'ri-building-line', count: 4 }, { id: 'announcements', name: 'Avis & Communiqués', icon: 'ri-megaphone-line', count: 6 }, { id: 'partners', name: 'Partenaires', icon: 'ri-handshake-line', count: 2 }, { id: 'media', name: 'Presse & Médias', icon: 'ri-camera-line', count: 3 } ]; setActiveCategory(categoryId: string) { this.activeCategory = categoryId; } }
